newsitem.title: CANADA: Investors drive up TVX after Greece update.
newsitem.headline: Investors drive up TVX after Greece update.

text.p: TVX Gold Inc topped the most-actives list for the Toronto Stock Exchange on Wednesday as investors digested an update on the company's mines in Greece.
TVX was up C$0.75 to 10.35 in trading of 5.9 million shares by mid-afternoon Wednesday.
Drilling on the properties so far suggests the mines contain at least 19 million ounces of gold, Ken Sangster, senior vice-president of European operations, said recently.
The company has outlined 10 million ounces at the Skouries mine, 5.5 million ounces at Olympias, three million ounces at Kasperske Hory and 500,000 ounces at the Asacha mine, he said.
"The numbers are actually surpassing my own rosy-glasses estimate," Eike Batista, TVX's chief executive, said. "They are extremely high grade so low costs are assumable."
The company will be a one-million-ounce-a-year producer by the year 2000 with the Greek mine production, he said.
Previously the company had expected to pass the one-million ounce mark in 1998.
The company has work to do on its Casa Berardi gold mine in Quebec, Cliff Davis, senior vice-president of North American operations.
TVX is considering its options to boost production and reserves at the mine, he said.
